speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: You are later than your brother. Gilbert was here at opening. He is gone back to St Bride's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was at Clerkenwell. Is the letter of the 26th gone down?

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: It is in the bag. Twopence the letter, and he paid it when he put it in. I do not take a letter twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is paid. Did you bring one from home?

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I brought one. It is on your stair at St Helen's. I do not fish a wife's letter back out of a house to hand it across a table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On the stair. Then I have not read it, and I will not have it read to me here.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: No more will I read it. The 26th is in the bag. We are done.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The bag is sped when the horses are fed. Twopence is already in my book. Good day, Master Shakespeare.
